test_title: PYST 5: SSC MTS 2023 - English (Held On: 04 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The ball / I kicked / went highly / in the sky.
solution:
The correct answer is **'**went highly'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**went highly**" is grammatically incorrect.
 
• The correct adverb to use with "**went**" in this context is "**high**," not "**highly**."
 
• "**Highly**" is used to modify adjectives or other adverbs, not verbs.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**went high in the sky**."

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Correct sentence: *The ball I kicked went high__ in the sky.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "The ball" -** This is the subject of the sentence and is grammatically correct.
 
• **Option 3: "in the sky" - **This phrase correctly indicates the location where the ball went.
 
• **Option 4: "I kicked" -** This phrase correctly describes the action performed.
